name: print-social-staying-active-tips-carousel-numbered-colour-cards
title: 'Staying Active During the Coronavirus Pandemic' numbered tip carousel in blue, teal and brown cards
whatItIs: A four-slide carousel (blue, teal, brown, red) each headed 'Staying Active During the Coronavirus Pandemic TIPS' with a checkmark, a large numeral (1, 2, 3) and a flat illustration (home workout on a laptop, a water bottle and timer, a boombox and playlist), shown mocked up on a phone for the closing card.
whatItMeans: Reassuring and practical; consistent numbering across colour-coded cards makes health advice easy to follow in order.
techniques: Number tips sequentially across a carousel.
Colour-code each slide while keeping layout identical.
Close the set with a phone mockup showing the final message.

vocabulary.definition: A sequence of slides each presenting one piece of advice.
A tick icon used to signal validated or trustworthy content.
